text.p: Freeport-McMoRan Inc said on Thursday Charles W. Goodyear has resigned as executive vice president and chief financial officer of the company and senior vice president and chief financial officer of Freeport-McMoRan Resource Partners LP.

Effective January 1, the company said, Michael J. Arnold will become senior vice president and chief administrative officer and Robert M. Wohleber will become senior vice president and chief financial officer of both the company and the partnership.
Arnold and Wohleber assume the responsibilities previously held by Goodyear, Freeport said.
In addition to pursuing other business opportunities, the company said, Goodyear has agreed to enter into a multi-year contract to provide financial advisory and consulting services to FTX and FRP.
The company said Richard C. Adkerson, vice chairman of FTX, will continue in his senior management oversight role in the financial and administrative affairs of FTX and FRP.

Arnold joined FTX in 1991 and is now vice president and controller - operations. Wohleber joined FTX in 1986 and became vice president in 1992. He is currently involved in the growth and business development activities of FTX and FRP.
Freeport-McMoRan Inc owns a 51.6 percent interest in Freeport-McMoRan Resource Partners.
